title: Groundhog Day
plot: A cynical and arrogant television weatherman named Phil Connors is sent to cover the annual Groundhog Day festivities in Punxsutawney, Pennsylvania. He wakes up the following morning to find himself trapped in a time loop, repeatedly reliving February 2nd over and over again. As he desperately tries to escape the repeating cycle, Phil indulges in reckless hedonism, falls in love with his producer Rita, and gradually undergoes profound self-examination to become a kinder person and break the loop.
actors: Bill Murray, Andie MacDowell, Chris Elliott, Stephen Tobolowsky

title: Edge of Tomorrow
plot: An untrained military media officer, Major William Cage, is demoted and forced into a brutal beach landing against an invading horde of biomechanical extraterrestrials known as Mimics. Cage is killed within minutes but inexplicably awakens twenty-four hours earlier in a continuous time loop. Teaming up with legendary special forces warrior Rita Vrataski, he repeatedly relives the same battle each day, improving his combat skills and searching for a way to defeat the alien hive mind.
actors: Tom Cruise, Emily Blunt, Bill Paxton, Brendan Gleeson

title: Palm Springs
plot: While attending a destination resort wedding in Palm Springs, carefree slacker Nyles and cynical maid of honor Sarah inadvertently enter a glowing desert cave and find themselves trapped in an infinite time loop. As they relive the same wedding day repeatedly, they develop a romantic connection while confronting their personal existential dread and seeking a scientific method to break free.
actors: Andy Samberg, Cristin Milioti, J.K. Simmons, Peter Gallagher

title: Inception
plot: Dom Cobb is a skilled corporate thief who specializes in the art of extraction, stealing valuable company secrets from deep within the subconscious minds of targets during the dream state. Offered a chance to have his criminal history erased so he can return home to his children, Cobb is tasked with the perilous opposite task: inception, planting an idea into the mind of a wealthy corporate heir through complex multi-layered shared dreams where gravity shifts and time dilates.
actors: Leonardo DiCaprio, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Elliot Page, Tom Hardy, Ken Watanabe, Cillian Murphy

title: The Matrix
plot: A solitary computer programmer and underground hacker known as Neo is contacted by mysterious resistance leader Morpheus, who reveals that perceived human reality is actually an elaborate computer-simulated reality called the Matrix, designed by artificial intelligence machines to subdue humanity while harvesting their bioelectric energy. Neo joins the rebellion to fulfill a prophecy as The One.
actors: Keanu Reeves, Laurence Fishburne, Carrie-Anne Moss, Hugo Weaving, Joe Pantoliano

title: Interstellar
plot: In a future where Earth's biosphere is collapsing from devastating global dust storms and agricultural blight, a former NASA test pilot named Cooper is recruited for a top-secret mission. Leading a team of researchers and scientists aboard the spacecraft Endurance, he travels through a newly discovered wormhole near Saturn to evaluate three distant candidate planets orbiting a supermassive black hole as possible new homes for humanity.
actors: Matthew McConaughey, Anne Hathaway, Jessica Chastain, Michael Caine, Matt Damon

title: Back to the Future
plot: Eccentric scientist Dr. Emmett Brown invents a time machine built into a modified plutonium-powered DeLorean sports car. When Libyan terrorists ambush Doc, seventeen-year-old Marty McFly accidentally activates the vehicle and is propelled thirty years into the past to 1955. Marty must reunite his estranged teenage parents and help them fall in love before his own existence is permanently erased.
actors: Michael J. Fox, Christopher Lloyd, Lea Thompson, Crispin Glover, Thomas F. Wilson

title: The Truman Show
plot: Truman Burbank lives a tranquil, routine life as an insurance salesman in the idyllic seaside town of Seahaven Island. Unbeknownst to him, his entire life since birth has been secretly filmed by thousands of hidden cameras and broadcast worldwide as a live non-stop reality television spectacle. Every resident, including his wife and best friend, is an actor living inside a massive dome.
actors: Jim Carrey, Laura Linney, Ed Harris, Noah Emmerich, Natascha McElhone

title: Blade Runner
plot: In a dystopian, rain-soaked cyberpunk Los Angeles in November 2019, burnt-out former police blade runner Rick Deckard is coerced into hunting down four rogue Nexus-6 humanoid replicants who have violently escaped from an off-world colony and returned to Earth searching for their creator to prolong their four-year lifespans.
actors: Harrison Ford, Rutger Hauer, Sean Young, Edward James Olmos, Daryl Hannah

title: Jurassic Park
plot: Billionaire philanthropist John Hammond creates an unprecedented wildlife theme park on a remote Costa Rican island featuring living dinosaurs cloned from prehistoric DNA extracted from fossilized amber. When an unscrupulous computer technician sabotages the park's security barriers to steal embryos, paleontologist Alan Grant and the visitors find themselves hunted across the island by velociraptors and a Tyrannosaurus rex.
actors: Sam Neill, Laura Dern, Jeff Goldblum, Richard Attenborough, Samuel L. Jackson

title: The Prestige
plot: In late 19th-century Victorian London, two ambitious stage magicians and former partners, Robert Angier and Alfred Borden, develop a bitter, lifelong rivalry following a tragic backstage accident. Their obsession to outdo one another leads to perilous escalation as Borden perfects an impossible teleportation act, driving Angier to seek revolutionary scientific apparatus from inventor Nikola Tesla.
actors: Hugh Jackman, Christian Bale, Michael Caine, Scarlett Johansson, David Bowie

title: Fight Club
plot: An unnamed automobile recall coordinator suffering from chronic insomnia and spiritual emptiness attends support groups for terminal diseases. On a business flight, he encounters Tyler Durden, a charismatic soap salesman. After his apartment is mysteriously destroyed, they move into a dilapidated house and establish an underground bare-knuckle fighting club for disenfranchised men that rapidly metastasizes into an anarchist terrorist collective.
actors: Brad Pitt, Edward Norton, Helena Bonham Carter, Meat Loaf, Jared Leto

title: The Shawshank Redemption
plot: In 1947, mild-mannered Portland banker Andy Dufresne is sentenced to consecutive life terms at Shawshank State Penitentiary for the double murder of his wife and her lover, despite claiming innocence. Over two decades of incarceration, Andy forms a deep bond with fellow inmate Red, helps corrupt prison guards with financial advice, and secretly conducts a patient, meticulous escape plan.
actors: Tim Robbins, Morgan Freeman, Bob Gunton, William Sadler, Clancy Brown

title: Spirited Away
plot: While relocating to a new town with her parents, ten-year-old Chihiro Ogino stumbles into a seemingly abandoned theme park that is actually a mystical resort bathhouse for spirits, kami, and magical entities. When her parents are turned into pigs by the sorceress Yubaba, Chihiro must renounce her name, take a job at the bathhouse, and navigate spirits with the help of a young river dragon spirit named Haku.
actors: Rumi Hiiragi, Miyu Irino, Mari Natsuki, Takashi Naito, Yasuko Sawaguchi

title: Alien
plot: The seven-member crew of the commercial towing vessel USCSS Nostromo is awakened from stasis by Mother, the ship's computer, to investigate an unidentified transmission coming from an uncharted moon. While inspecting a derelict extraterrestrial spacecraft, an alien egg releases an organism that attaches to an astronaut's face, ultimately spawning a deadly biomechanical creature that stalks the crew through dark corridors.
actors: Sigourney Weaver, Tom Skerritt, John Hurt, Veronica Cartwright, Harry Dean Stanton

title: Casablanca
plot: During World War II in unoccupied Vichy Morocco, world-weary American expatriate Rick Blaine runs an upscale nightclub and gambling den in Casablanca. His detached composure is shattered when his former lover Ilsa Lund walks in alongside her husband Victor Laszlo, a renowned Czech resistance leader fleeing Nazis, who urgently needs transit letters held by Rick.
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Ingrid Bergman, Paul Henreid, Claude Rains, Peter Lorre

title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
plot: After a painful breakup, introverted Joel Barish discovers that his free-spirited ex-girlfriend Clementine Kruczynski has hired a medical company named Lacuna to erase all memories of their relationship. Devastated, Joel undertakes the same neurological procedure, but as his memories of their love are systematically wiped backwards in his subconscious mind, he desperately tries to hide her in childhood memories.
actors: Jim Carrey, Kate Winslet, Kirsten Dunst, Mark Ruffalo, Elijah Wood

title: Memento
plot: Leonard Shelby is a former insurance investigator on an unrelenting quest to find the man who assaulted and murdered his wife. However, a head injury sustained during the attack left Leonard with anterograde amnesia, unable to form new short-term memories. Leonard uses intricate systems of Polaroid photos, handwritten notes, and permanent tattoos on his body to piece together clues in reverse chronological order.
actors: Guy Pearce, Carrie-Anne Moss, Joe Pantoliano, Mark Boone Junior

title: The Terminator
plot: In a post-apocalyptic future where artificial intelligence defense network Skynet seeks to exterminate surviving humans, a cyborg assassin known as a Cyberdyne Systems Model 101 Terminator is sent back in time to 1984 Los Angeles to assassinate Sarah Connor. Simultaneously, human soldier Kyle Reese travels back to protect Sarah, whose unborn son will lead humanity to victory against the machines.
actors: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Linda Hamilton, Michael Biehn, Paul Winfield

title: Titanic
plot: In April 1912, seventeen-year-old high-society aristocrat Rose DeWitt Bukater boards the luxurious ocean liner RMS Titanic alongside her domineering fiance and mother. Contemplating suicide over her arranged marriage, Rose is saved by penniless third-class artist Jack Dawson. They embark on a passionate romance across social barriers until the ship collides with an iceberg in the freezing North Atlantic.
actors: Leonardo DiCaprio, Kate Winslet, Billy Zane, Kathy Bates, Bill Paxton

title: Finding Nemo
plot: On the Great Barrier Reef, an anxious and overprotective clownfish named Marlin loses his curious son Nemo when he is captured by scuba divers and placed in a dentist's fish tank in Sydney. Accompanied by Dory, an optimistic blue tang suffering from short-term memory loss, Marlin embarks on an epic journey through jellyfish swarms, sharks, sea turtles, and pelicans to rescue his son.
actors: Albert Brooks, Ellen DeGeneres, Alexander Gould, Willem Dafoe, Allison Janney

title: Jaws
plot: When a young woman is killed by a giant predatory sea creature off the shores of Amity Island, police chief Martin Brody wants to close the beaches, but greedy town officials resist. After more gruesome attacks, Brody teams up with oceanographer Matt Hooper and seasoned, salty shark hunter Quint aboard the fishing boat Orca to hunt down a monstrous 25-foot great white shark.
actors: Roy Scheider, Robert Shaw, Richard Dreyfuss, Lorraine Gary, Murray Hamilton

title: Psycho
plot: Marion Crane, a Phoenix real estate secretary, impulsively steals forty thousand dollars in cash from her employer to help her indebted lover. Driving through a torrential rainstorm, she stops for the night at the remote Bates Motel, run by quiet, awkward taxidermist Norman Bates who lives in an eerie Victorian mansion on the hill under the tyrannical thumb of his puritanical mother.
actors: Anthony Perkins, Janet Leigh, Vera Miles, John Gavin, Martin Balsam

title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
plot: Beginning at the dawn of man when an enigmatic black monolith triggers evolutionary tool-use among hominids, humanity discovers a similar monolith buried beneath the lunar surface transmitting a signal toward Jupiter. Eighteen months later, astronauts David Bowman and Frank Poole travel to Jupiter aboard the Discovery One, accompanied by the ship's infallible, sentient artificial intelligence computer HAL 9000.
actors: Keir Dullea, Gary Lockwood, William Sylvester, Douglas Rain

title: The Silence of the Lambs
plot: Clarice Starling, an ambitious young FBI trainee, is assigned by Behavioral Science director Jack Crawford to interview imprisoned forensic psychiatrist and cannibalistic serial killer Dr. Hannibal Lecter. Crawford hopes Lecter can provide psychological insights into a spree killer known as Buffalo Bill, who kidnaps and flays young women. Lecter agrees only in exchange for intimate details about Clarice's childhood.
actors: Jodie Foster, Anthony Hopkins, Scott Glenn, Ted Levine, Anthony Heald

title: Pulp Fiction
plot: A series of eccentric, interconnected crime vignettes unfold out of chronological order in Los Angeles: two hitmen discuss cheeseburgers before executing a hit and dealing with an accidental shooting; a gangster's alluring wife suffers a heroin overdose requiring an adrenaline injection to her heart; an aging boxer betrays a mob boss by winning a bout and flees with his girlfriend.
actors: John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Uma Thurman, Bruce Willis, Ving Rhames

title: Parasite
plot: The Kim family lives in a squalid Seoul semi-basement, struggling to make ends meet with low-paying odd jobs. When the son Ki-woo gets an opportunity to tutor the daughter of the affluent Park family, the Kims systematically orchestrate the firing of existing staff to infiltrate the luxurious mansion as unrelated household employees, until a hidden subterranean bunker reveals a dark secret.
actors: Song Kang-ho, Lee Sun-kyun, Cho Yeo-jeong, Choi Woo-shik, Park So-dam

title: Whiplash
plot: Andrew Neiman is a determined nineteen-year-old first-year jazz drumming student at the prestigious Shaffer Conservatory of Music in New York City. He catches the attention of Terence Fletcher, an intimidating, abusive studio band conductor who uses psychological humiliation and physical violence to push students beyond the brink of sanity in pursuit of artistic perfection.
actors: Miles Teller, J.K. Simmons, Paul Reiser, Melissa Benoist

title: La La Land
plot: In sun-drenched contemporary Los Angeles, aspiring actress Mia serves coffee on a studio lot between demoralizing auditions, while passionate jazz purist Sebastian plays holiday tunes in a restaurant while dreaming of opening his own club. They cross paths, fall in love, and encourage one another's ambitions, but find their romance strained as their careers pull them in separate directions.
actors: Ryan Gosling, Emma Stone, John Legend, Rosemarie DeWitt, J.K. Simmons

title: The Dark Knight
plot: With the assistance of Lieutenant Jim Gordon and newly elected heroic District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman keeps the lid on crime in Gotham City. However, an anarchic, sadistic criminal mastermind calling himself the Joker emerges from the criminal underworld, unleashing chaotic terrorist bombings and psychological dilemmas designed to corrupt Dent and push Batman into breaking his moral code.
actors: Christian Bale, Heath Ledger, Aaron Eckhart, Michael Caine, Maggie Gyllenhaal, Gary Oldman, Morgan Freeman

title: The Sixth Sense
plot: Dr. Malcolm Crowe is a dedicated Philadelphia child psychologist recovering from an attack by a disturbed former patient. Crowe takes on the challenging case of Cole Sear, a terrified, introverted eight-year-old boy who confesses that he has the supernatural ability to see dead people walking among the living, unaware that they are dead.
actors: Bruce Willis, Haley Joel Osment, Toni Collette, Olivia Williams

title: Good Will Hunting
plot: Will Hunting is a twenty-year-old South Boston laborer working as a janitor at MIT who possesses a photographic memory and an innate genius for advanced mathematics. After anonymously solving an impossible algebraic theorem on a hallway chalkboard, Will faces imprisonment for assault. An MIT professor arranges for him to avoid jail by studying math and undergoing therapy with an empathetic psychologist named Sean Maguire.
actors: Matt Damon, Robin Williams, Ben Affleck, Stellan Skarsgård, Minnie Driver

title: Toy Story
plot: In a world where toys come to life when humans are absent, vintage pull-string cowboy doll Woody is the beloved favorite of six-year-old Andy. When Andy receives a sleek, modern Buzz Lightyear space ranger action figure for his birthday who genuinely believes he is a real astronaut, Woody's jealousy triggers a rivalry that lands them stranded outside Andy's house in the hands of a sadistic neighbor.
actors: Tom Hanks, Tim Allen, Don Rickles, Jim Varney, Wallace Shawn

title: Monsters, Inc.
plot: In the city of Monstropolis, the Monsters, Inc. power factory harvests energy by sending scarers through closet doors into human bedrooms to capture children's screams. When top scarer James P. 'Sulley' Sullivan and his one-eyed best friend Mike Wazowski accidentally allow an unafraid human toddler girl named Boo into the monster world, they must protect her from a sinister conspiracy.
actors: John Goodman, Billy Crystal, Steve Buscemi, James Coburn, Jennifer Tilly

title: The Social Network
plot: In autumn 2003, Harvard sophomore and computer programmer Mark Zuckerberg creates an online rating site called Facemash after being dumped, which quickly evolves into an exclusive campus social networking platform known as The Facebook. Funded by his friend Eduardo Saverin, the site expands globally, leading to multi-million dollar lawsuits from the Winklevoss twins and the bitter estrangement of his best friend.
actors: Jesse Eisenberg, Andrew Garfield, Justin Timberlake, Armie Hammer, Max Minghella

title: Get Out
plot: Chris Washington, an African-American photographer, travels upstate with his white girlfriend Rose Armitage to spend a weekend meeting her neurosurgeon father and hypnotherapist mother. Although initially accommodating, the family and their affluent white guests exhibit unsettling behavior, leading Chris to discover a horrifying medical conspiracy where older patrons transplant their consciousness into abducted black bodies.
actors: Daniel Kaluuya, Allison Williams, Bradley Whitford, Catherine Keener, Caleb Landry Jones

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
plot: In a post-apocalyptic Australian desert wasteland ruled by tyrannical warlord Immortan Joe who controls the water supply, one-armed lieutenant Imperator Furiosa betrays Joe by escaping in an armored War Rig with his five captive breeding wives. Teaming up with Max Rockatansky, a haunted lone drifter captured as a universal blood donor, they wage a high-octane vehicular war across the desert.
actors: Tom Hardy, Charlize Theron, Nicholas Hoult, Hugh Keays-Byrne

title: Cast Away
plot: Chuck Noland, a fastidious FedEx systems engineer obsessed with efficiency and punctuality, survives a terrifying cargo plane crash in the South Pacific during a storm. Stranded as the sole survivor on an uninhabited tropical island, Chuck must learn to forage, find fresh water, make fire, and preserve his sanity over four grueling years with only a washed-ashore volleyball named Wilson.
actors: Tom Hanks, Helen Hunt, Nick Searcy, Chris Noth

title: A Quiet Place
plot: In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by blind, armored extraterrestrial predators that hunt entirely by acoustic sound, the Abbott family lives on an isolated farm in total silence. They communicate exclusively using sign language, walk barefoot on laid sand paths, and use warning light bulbs to navigate daily survival while preparing for the birth of a new baby in silence.

title: Arrival
plot: Twelve colossal extraterrestrial spacecraft hover over disparate global locations. The US military enlists linguistics professor Louise Banks and theoretical physicist Ian Donnelly to establish communication with the heptapod alien visitors. As Louise deciphers their complex circular ink logograms, she begins experiencing non-linear memories and realizes that learning their language alters human perception of time.
actors: Amy Adams, Jeremy Renner, Forest Whitaker, Michael Stuhlbarg

title: The Big Lebowski
plot: Jeffrey 'The Dude' Lebowski is an unemployed, bowling-obsessed Los Angeles slacker who is violently attacked by debt collectors mistaking him for a multi-millionaire of the same name. Seeking reimbursement for his ruined rug from the real Big Lebowski, The Dude is hired to deliver a ransom when the millionaire's trophy wife is purportedly kidnapped, entangling him with nihilists, bowlers, and eccentric artists.
actors: Jeff Bridges, John Goodman, Julianne Moore, Steve Buscemi, John Turturro

title: Fargo
plot: In snowy Minnesota, financially desperate car salesman Jerry Lundegaard arranges for two bumbling criminals to kidnap his own wife so he can extort a massive ransom from his wealthy father-in-law. When the botched kidnapping results in three murders on a rural highway, upbeat and heavily pregnant Brainerd police chief Marge Gunderson investigates the gruesome crime trail.
actors: Frances McDormand, William H. Macy, Steve Buscemi, Peter Stormare

title: Shutter Island
plot: In 1954, US Marshal Edward 'Teddy' Daniels and his newly assigned partner Chuck Aule travel by ferry to Ashecliffe Hospital, a fortress-like psychiatric asylum for the criminally insane on a wind-swept Boston Harbor island, to investigate the baffling disappearance of a patient who drowned her children. As a hurricane strands them, Teddy suspects dark psychiatric experiments on patients.
actors: Leonardo DiCaprio, Mark Ruffalo, Ben Kingsley, Max von Sydow, Michelle Williams

title: Catch Me If You Can
plot: Inspired by the true story of Frank Abagnale Jr., who before his nineteenth birthday successfully performed check fraud worth millions by posing as a Pan Am airline co-pilot, a Georgia hospital pediatrician, and a Louisiana assistant district attorney. Hard-nosed FBI bank fraud investigator Carl Hanratty makes it his personal mission to track down and capture the youthful con artist.
actors: Leonardo DiCaprio, Tom Hanks, Christopher Walken, Martin Sheen, Nathalie Baye

title: Pan's Labyrinth
plot: In 1944 Francoist Spain, young and imaginative Ofelia travels with her pregnant mother to a remote mountain mill outpost where her new stepfather, a sadistic Falangist army captain, hunts anti-fascist guerrilla rebels. At night, Ofelia is led by a stick insect into an ancient stone labyrinth where an enigmatic faun informs her she is the lost princess of the Underworld and must complete three perilous tasks.
actors: Ivana Baquero, Sergi López, Maribel Verdú, Doug Jones, Ariadna Gil

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
plot: In the fictional war-torn European Republic of Zubrowka between the world wars, legendary concierge Monsieur Gustave H. of the luxury Grand Budapest Hotel prides himself on impeccable guest service. When his wealthy elderly lover is mysteriously murdered and leaves him a priceless Renaissance painting, Gustave is framed for murder and escapes from prison with the help of his loyal lobby boy Zero Moustafa.
actors: Ralph Fiennes, F. Murray Abraham, Mathieu Amalric, Adrien Brody, Willem Dafoe

title: Coco
plot: In a Mexican town, twelve-year-old Miguel Rivera secretly dreams of becoming an accomplished musician like his idol Ernesto de la Cruz, despite his shoemaking family's generations-old strict ban on music. On the Day of the Dead, Miguel tries to borrow de la Cruz's guitar from his mausoleum and is magically transported to the vibrant Land of the Dead, where he must find his ancestral blessing to return.
actors: Anthony Gonzalez, Gael García Bernal, Benjamin Bratt, Alanna Ubach

title: Gladiator
plot: In 180 AD, victorious Roman general Maximus Decimus Meridius is chosen by dying Emperor Marcus Aurelius to succeed him and restore the Roman Republic. Enraged, Aurelius's corrupt son Commodus murders his father and orders Maximus and his family executed. Escaping his assassins, Maximus is enslaved and trained as a gladiator, rising through the sands of the Colosseum arena to exact vengeance.
actors: Russell Crowe, Joaquin Phoenix, Connie Nielsen, Oliver Reed, Derek Jacobi

title: The Princess Bride
plot: A grandfather reads a classic bedtime fairy tale to his sick grandson about a beautiful young woman named Buttercup and her true love, the farmhand Westley. After Westley is captured by the Dread Pirate Roberts and presumed dead, Buttercup is forced into an engagement with the odious Prince Humperdinck, prompting Westley to return in disguise and embark on an adventure with an expert Spanish swordsman.
actors: Cary Elwes, Robin Wright, Mandy Patinkin, Chris Sarandon, Wallace Shawn, André the Giant

title: Seven
plot: In a perpetually rain-soaked, decaying metropolis, retiring police detective William Somerset is paired with impulsive, newly transferred detective David Mills. They discover that a methodical serial killer named John Doe is staging grotesque, elaborate murders, each elaborately designed to punish a victim representing one of the seven deadly sins: gluttony, greed, sloth, lust, pride, envy, and wrath.

title: 12 Angry Men
plot: On the hottest afternoon of the year in a cramped New York City courthouse deliberation room, twelve male jurors are tasked with determining the verdict in the first-degree murder trial of an impoverished eighteen-year-old youth accused of stabbing his abusive father. While eleven jurors immediately vote guilty, Juror 8 stands alone with a vote of not guilty, forcing the men to examine their personal prejudices.
actors: Henry Fonda, Lee J. Cobb, Martin Balsam, Ed Begley, Jack Warden

title: Rocky
plot: Rocky Balboa is a gentle-hearted, small-time southpaw boxer and debt collector living in Philadelphia. When heavyweight world champion Apollo Creed needs an opponent for a high-profile bicentennial exhibition match after his scheduled challenger is injured, he gives the unknown 'Italian Stallion' a once-in-a-lifetime title shot. Trained by gruff veteran Mickey, Rocky fights to go the distance.
actors: Sylvester Stallone, Talia Shire, Burt Young, Carl Weathers, Burgess Meredith

title: Rear Window
plot: Professional photographer L.B. 'Jeff' Jefferies is recuperating in his Greenwich Village apartment, confined to a wheelchair with a broken leg during a summer heatwave. To pass the time, Jeff watches the everyday activities of his courtyard neighbors through binoculars and a telephoto lens, gradually becoming convinced that a traveling salesman across the yard has murdered his invalid wife.
actors: James Stewart, Grace Kelly, Wendell Corey, Thelma Ritter, Raymond Burr

title: The Shining
plot: Jack Torrance, an aspiring writer and recovering alcoholic, takes a job as the winter caretaker of the remote Overlook Hotel high in the Colorado Rockies, bringing along his wife Wendy and young telepathic son Danny. As winter blizzards isolate the family, supernatural malevolent forces residing in the hotel prey upon Jack's fragile psyche, driving him into homicidal madness.
actors: Jack Nicholson, Shelley Duvall, Danny Lloyd, Scatman Crothers

title: The Departed
plot: In South Boston, the Massachusetts State Police wage an all-out war against Irish-American crime boss Frank Costello. Rookie undercover cop Billy Costigan is tasked with infiltrating Costello's inner gang, while Costello plants Colin Sullivan as an ambitious young mole inside the Special Investigation Unit. When both organizations realize a mole exists, both men scramble to uncover the other's identity.
actors: Leonardo DiCaprio, Matt Damon, Jack Nicholson, Mark Wahlberg, Martin Sheen

title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
plot: In 1936, globetrotting archaeology professor Indiana Jones is recruited by Army Intelligence to find the biblical Ark of the Covenant, an ancient gold-plated chest said to hold the Ten Commandments and render any army invincible. Jones races across Peru, Nepal, and Egypt to locate the Ark before Nazi German expedition forces can seize its supernatural power.
actors: Harrison Ford, Karen Allen, Paul Freeman, John Rhys-Davies, Denholm Elliott

title: Gifted
plot: Frank Adler is a single man raising his spirited young niece Mary, a child prodigy with extraordinary mathematical abilities, in a coastal Florida town. Frank is dedicated to giving Mary a normal childhood and fulfilling a promise to his late sister, but when her mathematical genius comes to light, Frank's formidable mother Evelyn intervenes and initiates a bitter custody battle to take Mary away from her uncle and groom her for academia.
actors: Chris Evans, Mckenna Grace, Lindsay Duncan, Jenny Slate, Octavia Spencer
